decisive_items: Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)
response.rationale: Only one candidate was supplied, and its raw support spans directly match the vignette's photosensitive eruption, nailfold capillary changes, anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies, and elevated IFN-β, which together strongly support juvenile dermatomyositis.
